calculation.description: Cross-asset reversal signal formed by averaging the latest three bounded one-day returns. The signal uses data through t and predicts next-day returns; bounding limits the impact of shock observations while smoothing reduces rank churn.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across 2020-2022, 2023-2024, 2025-2026, and 2027-2028; strongest in 2025-2026. Ten-day decay is negative, so the factor is intended for short-horizon ensemble use and capped exposure under ten-day cadence.
